additions.name: Antel Datacenter Internacional Ing. José Luis Massera, Pando — existing commercial operations

status.summary: The Presidency reports that Antel operates its existing data centre at Parque Industrial y Tecnológico de Pando.

locator.precision: Representative point inside the contributor-mapped Antel campus. It locates the named establishment. It has no surveyed accuracy and does not represent the building, a cadastral boundary or unit B/01.
locator.identity_review: The operator’s full Massera facility name and Parque Industrial de Pando location match the independently named OSM industrial-campus way. The government confirms Pando’s operating host. Padrón 9702 covers a larger industrial park; its geometry and the internal building feature are not used as the locator.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The OpenStreetMap feature supplies no surveyed horizontal accuracy or numeric uncertainty.

additions.distinctness_review: Searches for Antel, Pando, Massera and the map-object ID covered all 1,347 sites, 1,465 projects, 231 imported source records and both 231-entry mapping arrays. The nearest existing site geometry is Google Canelones Uruguay Data Center, 10,784 metres from the mapped Pando campus. The separate building feature with the operator and facility name describes the same host. Certification phases and the future Las Piedras project are outside this admission.
additions.successor_review: November 10 explicitly confirms continuing operation at Pando. The operator’s November 16 event discusses expansion and a separate Las Piedras project. It gives no commissioning date for additional computing capacity.

additions.name: Chunghwa Telecom Tainan Zhongshan IDC operations

status.summary: CHT identifies customers receiving Internet connectivity at its Tainan Zhongshan IDC in its October 1 notice. It markets the facility for commercial colocation.

locator.precision: Municipal address reference for the host building at 207 Zhongshan Road. The city positions doorplates manually and reports no per-record survey accuracy.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The released municipal address-point data provides no positional accuracy for this row. The feature locates the building address.
locator.identity_review: The CHT facility page and separate SGS verification table name the Tainan Zhongshan facility at the same address. The Tainan City register has a unique unsuffixed municipal doorplate for Zhongshan Road 207 in West Central District.

additions.distinctness_review: The name, Zhongshan transliterations and local Chinese spellings were screened across all five identity layers. The two existing mapped sites in Taiwan are in Taipei and Taoyuan. All 1,347 complete site geometries were compared. The nearest is BDx TPE1 Data Center, No. 18 Wenhua East Road, Guishan, Taoyuan at 256.1 km. Independent facility names distinguish Tainan Zhongshan from Kaohsiung Zhongshan and Tainan Yongkang.
additions.successor_review: The public operator roster and service notices checked through November 25 continue to list the site. The notice establishes existing customers on October 1; the later date it schedules for network work is prospective.
